images.filename: Lena’s House Folk Museum, Mykonos, Greece (53505805700) (cropped).jpg
images.caption: Built in the mid-19th Century, this vernacular Cycladic-style house was constructed for a middle-class family in the Mykonos Chora, or main town.  The house features a limewashed exterior with stone trim at the windows and doorways, casement windows, and an interior that has been restored to its original interior.  The building today has been restored and opened to the public as a museum that interprets the history of Mykonos.
images.alt: Built in the mid-19th Century, this vernacular Cycladic-style house was constructed for a middle-class family in the Mykonos Chora, or main town.  The house features a limewashed exterior with stone trim at the windows and doorways, casement windows, and an interior that has been restored to its original interior.  The building today has been restored and opened to the public as a museum that interprets the history of Mykonos.

images.caption: Aerial view of Pula, Croatia. The most notable object, on the bottom of the photo, is the Arena Amphiteathre. Left of it is the hill around which lies the Old Town.
